Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

vespa 0.6.0

  • Reorganize documentation website.

vespa 0.5.0

vespa 0.4.0

  • Add extract_isosurface() for sdf_volume objects.
  • signed_distance_function() now return a sdf_volume object.
  • Add Signed Distance Function and Poisson Surface Reconstruction vignettes.

vespa 0.3.0

  • Renaming of all exported functions for better transparency.

vespa 0.2.0

  • Bump to vespa version 1.0.0.

vespa 0.1.0

  • Initial vespa wrapper.
